title: Self-service appointment rebooking
body:
## English
Let people rebook a missed appointment online without phoning the clinic.

## Cymraeg
Gadael i bobl aildrefnu apwyntiad a gollwyd ar-lein heb ffonio'r clinig.

title: Calendar export for appointments
body:
## English
Add appointments to a personal calendar with one tap.

## Cymraeg
Ychwanegu apwyntiadau at galendr personol ag un tap.

title: Bilingual appointment letters
body:
## English
Generate appointment letters in Welsh and English from one template.

## Cymraeg
Cynhyrchu llythyrau apwyntiad yn Gymraeg a Saesneg o un templed.

title: Single sign-on for clinic staff
body:
## English
Let clinic staff sign in once across all immunisation tools.

## Cymraeg
Gadael i staff y clinig fewngofnodi unwaith ar draws yr holl offer imiwneiddio.

title: Welsh-language SMS reminders by default
body:
## English
Send reminders in a person's chosen language by default.

## Cymraeg
Anfon nodiadau atgoffa yn iaith ddewisol y person yn ddiofyn.

title: Offline mode for rural clinics
body:
## English
Work without a connection and sync when the network returns.

## Cymraeg
Gweithio heb gysylltiad a chysoni pan ddaw'r rhwydwaith yn ôl.

title: Barcode scanning for vaccine batch numbers
body:
## English
Scan a barcode to capture vaccine batch numbers accurately.

## Cymraeg
Sganio cod bar i gofnodi rhifau swp brechlyn yn gywir.

title: Native mobile app for patients
body:
## English
A dedicated patient app for booking and reminders.

## Cymraeg
Ap pwrpasol i gleifion ar gyfer archebu a nodiadau atgoffa.

## Decision
We are not building a native app now. The web service covers these needs and a separate app would split effort.

## Penderfyniad
Nid ydym yn adeiladu ap brodorol nawr. Mae'r gwasanaeth gwe yn diwallu'r anghenion hyn a byddai ap ar wahan yn rhannu ymdrech.

title: Accessible colour contrast across the dashboard
body:
## English
Dashboard colours now meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast.

## Cymraeg
Mae lliwiau'r dangosfwrdd bellach yn bodloni cyferbyniad WCAG 2.2 AA.

title: Please add a dark mode
body:
## English
A dark theme would be easier on the eyes.

## Cymraeg
Byddai thema dywyll yn haws ar y llygaid.

title: Integrate with a third-party scheduler
body:
## English
Use an external scheduler instead of ours.

## Cymraeg
Defnyddio amserlennydd allanol yn lle ein un ni.

title: Fix typo in readme
body: Not a real backlog item; a pull request that must be excluded.
